newsitem.title: USA: United sees strength continuing for rest of 1997.
newsitem.headline: United sees strength continuing for rest of 1997.

text.p: United Airlines said it expects 1997 to be another record year and sees second quarter earnings up slightly over last year.

United, a division of UAL Corp, declined to provide specific goals for the year or the second quarter. In the second quarter of 1996, UAL earned $2.52 per fully distributed share before debt repurchases.

Earlier on Tuesday, United posted first quarter operating earnings of $1.61 per fully distributed share, compared to $0.72 per fully distributed share. First quarter revenues increased to $4.12 billion from $3.73 billion.
